SCOUT_DIGEST/v1

coverage_date: 2026-09-11
source: weekly Research Scout press/research review supplied by Pasha and independently spot-verified against primary/current sources
execution_authorized: false

## Strongest findings

1. **Beyond Agent Harnesses: Cross-Substrate Authority for Multi-Agent Systems** — Li et al., arXiv:2609.08472, submitted 2026-09-08. Primary result directly supports separating planner-visible semantic state from external authority state. Controlled experiments report that authority evidence helps planning but model planning remains unreliable; a deterministic execution guard at the mutation boundary prevented the tested unauthorized effects while permitting authorized effects. Architectural handoff: `semantic decision != authority to mutate`; use explicit authority evidence plus mutation-boundary enforcement.
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08472

2. **The Shape of Ownership: Verifying LLM Provenance through Semantic Structures (PROSE)** — Sun et al., arXiv:2609.02553, submitted 2026-09-02. Encodes behavioral provenance in relational semantic structure rather than fixed secret query/answer tokens; verifies via held-out natural queries. Authors report 100% detection on unmodified tested models with no observed false positives and robustness to tested downstream modifications. Architectural handoff: strong baseline/reference for Reverse Semantic GPS; identity/fingerprint may live in repeated relational behavior rather than one object hash.
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02553

3. **Agent Authorization Envelope (AAE) draft-02** — Lars Kroehl, independent Internet-Draft draft-kroehl-agentic-trust-aae-02, published 2026-09-06; intended Informational, NOT an adopted IETF standard. Defines mandatory `MANDATE`, `CONSTRAINTS`, `VALIDITY`; DID/VC/JWS/Ed25519-based envelope; grant-level SHA-256 `action_binding`; grants refine and never extend mandate; fail-closed if required constraints/grant procedure cannot be evaluated. Architectural handoff: protocol-design reference for sovereign SSI and per-effect authorization.
Source: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-kroehl-agentic-trust-aae-02

4. **Block-wide Signature Aggregation via SNARKs** — Delving Bitcoin protocol discussion begun 2026-09-04 and active through 2026-09-10. Explores aggregating validation of many large post-quantum signatures into a succinct proof; zero knowledge is not required. Architectural handoff: candidate analogy for `many claim witnesses -> one compact settlement-validity proof`, but currently protocol exploration rather than settled Bitcoin proposal.
Source: https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/block-wide-signature-aggregation-via-snarks/2875

5. **PSBT/MuSig2 coordination over Nostr relays** — Delving Bitcoin discussion active through 2026-09-09. At-least-once transport requires signer-local idempotency; duplicate delivery resends cached bytes rather than re-signing; conflicting session state aborts. Discussion explicitly highlights crash/restore risk: consumed nonce state must not be resurrected; safe resumability requires the consumed marker durable before `Sign` returns. Architectural handoff: `duplicate delivery != duplicate execution`; idempotency belongs to executor state machine, not transport; direct regression reference for mailbox self-heal/Prometheus.
Source: https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/psbt-musig2-coordination-over-nostr-relays-transport-invariants-for-nonce-safety-under-at-least-once-delivery/2852

6. **Bitcoin PQ identity/key lifecycle** — September 2026 PQC discussion plus Bitcoin Optech #421. The ecosystem discussion increasingly treats PQ migration as more than swapping a signature primitive; SHRINCS draft itself specifies a signature scheme while output/deployment remains separate. Architectural handoff: sovereign identity must model seed/derivation/state/backup/rotation/address/authorization lifecycle rather than equating identity with a public key.
Source: https://bitcoinops.org/en/newsletters/2026/09/04/

## Synthesis

The strongest ChitAkasha chain from this week's evidence is:

`observation -> semantic fingerprint -> claim -> authority evidence -> intent -> deterministic mutation guard -> effect -> settlement proof`

Keep three hash roles separate:
- semantic hash / relational fingerprint: locate behavioral region/type/route;
- action binding: prove authorization applies to this canonical action type/effect;
- cryptographic commitment: bind exact evidence/data for later verification.

## Ranked handoffs

P0 conceptual handoff: #100 Sovereign SSI — incorporate cross-substrate authority + AAE as primary references, preserving `WILL may narrow MAY, never expand it` and deterministic mutation-boundary enforcement.

P1 protocol handoff: #101 Prometheus Blocker Intelligence — incorporate MuSig2/Nostr replay/restore invariants into retry/idempotency taxonomy.

P1 research handoff: Reverse Semantic GPS — use PROSE as a baseline/reference for relational behavioral fingerprinting. Do NOT rerun #86 lexical encoder merely because PROSE is promising; any successor needs a genuinely different encoder and independently defined evaluation corpus.

No Bloom-filter handoff this week: Scout found no sufficiently strong new primary source and did not manufacture one.
